requirements_summary: Workload: IDE copilot + code search; needs embeddings over private repos + local context window stitching
Latency: 50-120ms token-level streaming target for local dev instances; 99th pct SLA goal 250ms for single-line completions
Throughput: expected 200 concurrent active devs during peak; batching must not break low-latency requirement
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for dedicated capacity if predictable
Model needs: ability to pin model version per workspace; deterministic rollouts for model upgrades
Vector DB: must support customer-owned vector DB or hosted with residency controls (EU/NA tenancy), prefer VPC peering
Chunking & context: repo-aware chunking with file/type-aware weights; prefer embeddings generated with stable hash/versioning
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Ingest 10 repos (~2M LOC) into test vector store; validate chunking heuristics and embedding recall
Phase 2 (2 weeks): Integrate streaming completions in VS Code extension; measure latency and token continuity
Phase 3 (2-4 weeks): Private deployment in VPC with pinned model and canary rollout test; run quality/regression evals
Success metrics: retrieval R@5 >= 0.85 on internal eval prompts; mean token latency <120ms; no data egress outside region
security_review: Requested: SOC2 report, ISO summary, SSO/SAML flow diagram
